referenceMethod: Exact lossless unscaled Sharp extraction before image generation.

registration.normalizedMapping: Map complete image into x600,y320,width500,height400 inside original fabric tile. No additional crop.
registration.visualAssessment: Inspected source master, exact crop and generated native output. The thin sloping upper seam, lower cushion edge/gap and broad weave landmarks remain in the same relative arrangement. Match is closer than the rejected whole-tile fabric v2. Generated loops are slightly brighter and crisper, so transition/composite should still be reviewed.
registration.limits: Visual alignment only; not a guarantee of identical underlying threads or pixel-perfect registration. The 0.036 percent aspect difference comes from native output dimensions. No quantitative microscopic or documentary claims.
